lines.en: label sarabar20:
scene barsaraayane1
I decide to spend a totally normal night at the bar where nothing can possibly go wrong.
lines.zh: 我决定在酒吧过一个完全正常的夜晚，一个绝不可能出任何岔子的夜晚。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane2
: What’re ya drinkin’ stranger?
lines.zh: : 喝点什么呀，陌生人？

lines.en: I fail miserably.
lines.zh: 我失败得一塌糊涂。

lines.en: : Whiskey on the rocks. No ice.
lines.zh: : 威士忌加冰。不加冰。

lines.en: : Comin’ right up, champ.
lines.zh: : 马上来，冠军。

lines.en: : Ayane, don’t agree to that. It’s literally not possible.
lines.zh: : Ayane，别答应那个。这在字面上就不可能。

lines.en: : I ain’t Ayane, bud. I’m Efrosinia Aleksandrova, Russian spy.
lines.zh: : 我不是 Ayane，老兄。我是 Efrosinia Aleksandrova，俄罗斯间谍。

lines.en: : You are equally bad at that job as well, then.
lines.zh: : 那你在那份工作上也同样糟糕。

lines.en: : Where are the people who actually work here?
lines.zh: : 真正在这儿工作的人都去哪儿了？

lines.en: scene barsaraayane3
: I...tried to stop her...but...
lines.zh: : 我……试着阻止她了……可是……

lines.en: : My mom is...stronger than I am...
lines.zh: : 我妈妈……比我力气大……

lines.en: : You still want that orange soda, champ?
lines.zh: : 你还要那杯橙味汽水吗，冠军？

lines.en: : Ayane, please take off that uniform.
lines.zh: : Ayane，请把那身制服脱了。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane4
: Here? Shouldn't we wash the counters first?
lines.zh: : 在这儿？不该先把吧台擦一擦吗？

lines.en: : I think...there are bigger issues than the counters...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……有比吧台更严重的问题……

lines.en: : You guys didn’t hire Aya-
lines.zh: : 你们该不会雇了 Aya——

lines.en: : Efrosinia.
lines.zh: : Efrosinia。

lines.en: : You guys didn’t hire Efrosinia, did you?
lines.zh: : 你们该不会雇了 Efrosinia 吧？

lines.en: scene barsaraayane5

lines.zh: : 没有……

lines.en: : Well...not really...
lines.zh: : 嗯……也不算……

lines.en: : Ayane and I were hanging out and...my mom asked if we could come help her with something...
lines.zh: : 我和 Ayane 在一起玩，然后……我妈问我俩能不能来帮她个忙……

lines.en: : Efrosinia. But yes.
lines.zh: : Efrosinia。不过是的。

lines.en: : Sana and I are going to fix this bar, Sensei. Watch.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我和 Sana 要把这家酒吧救回来。等着瞧吧。

lines.en: : How? You haven’t even served me yet and I’m literally the only customer.
lines.zh: : 怎么救？你连我这一杯都还没上呢，而我可是这里唯一的客人。

lines.en: : I didn’t ask for their help to serve customers, Sensei. I need them for marketing stuff.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我叫她们来不是帮忙招待客人的。我需要她们帮忙搞营销。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane6
: Woah. When did you get there?
lines.zh: : 哇哦。你什么时候坐过去的？

lines.en: : I just sat down a second ago. Don’t freak out.
lines.zh: : 我刚坐下没多久。别大惊小怪的。

lines.en: : Okay, good. I would have felt bad if I ignored you in favor of a younger girl wearing the same outfit.
lines.zh: : 好，那就好。要是我为了一个穿同样制服的年轻女孩而无视你，我会过意不去的。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane7
: Wait, Sensei! It’s me, Ayane!
lines.zh: : 等等，Sensei！是我呀，Ayane！

lines.en: : I’m not Efrosinia at all! Notice me! Not Sana’s mom!
lines.zh: : 我根本不是 Efrosinia！看我看我！别看 Sana 的妈妈！

lines.en: : Ayane...why don’t you take off that uniform now, dear?
lines.zh: : Ayane……你现在把那身制服脱了吧，亲爱的？

lines.en: scene barsaraayane8
: Why is everyone so horny tonight?!
lines.zh: : 为什么今晚所有人都这么饥渴？！

lines.en: : Fine! But only if Sensei is participating as well!
lines.zh: : 好！但前提是 Sensei 也得参与！

lines.en: : Sorry, Sana. Would you mind leaving a little early tonight?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Sana。你今晚能早点走吗？

lines.en: : Huh?...What?...
: I...zoned out for a second...
lines.zh: : 我……走神了一下……

lines.en: : What are you doing with those two that I can’t...be around for?
lines.zh: : 你要和她俩做什么，是我不能……在场的？

lines.en: : Whatever it is...I’m sure I could contribute in...some way...
lines.zh: : 不管是什么……我肯定也能……帮上点忙……

lines.en: scene barsaraayane9
: Really? I didn’t think you were ready for that yet.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？我没想到你已经准备好那一步了。

lines.en: : Oh, my sweet Sana. I love you, but I think you should stay out of this.
lines.zh: : 哦，我可爱的 Sana。我爱你，不过我觉得这事你还是别掺和了。

lines.en: : That’s right. Sensei is an adult who-
lines.zh: : 没错。Sensei 是个成年人，他——

lines.en: scene barsaraayane10
: You too, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 你也一样，Ayane。

lines.en: : You can keep the outfit as payment for helping me out, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那身制服你可以留着，就当是帮我的报酬。

lines.en: : Thank you! It’s extremely cute and I will handle it with care!
lines.zh: : 谢谢！它超级可爱，我一定会好好保管的！

lines.en: : I promise I won’t use it for anything naughty either!
lines.zh: : 我也保证不会拿它做什么下流的事！

lines.en: : Na...naughty?...
: Sana, would you mind taking your friend upstairs and helping her put her normal clothes back on since she seems so against doing it on her own?
lines.zh: : Sana，你介意带你朋友上楼、帮她把平时的衣服换回来吗？她看起来是打死都不肯自己换。

lines.en: : Oh...um...yes, but...
lines.zh: : 哦……嗯……好的，不过……

lines.en: : Do you still need me around tonight?...
lines.zh: : 今晚还需要我在吗？……

lines.en: : Because Ayane and I were...
lines.zh: : 因为我和 Ayane 本来……

lines.en: : Not anymore, dear. I already told you everything I wanted to tell you.
lines.zh: : 不用了，亲爱的。我想跟你说的都说完了。

lines.en: : The two of you are free to leave whenever you want since I’ll be closing any minute now.
lines.zh: : 你们俩想走随时可以走，反正我马上就要打烊了。

lines.en: : Oh...okay...
: Umm...afro...xena?
lines.zh: : 嗯……afro……xena？

lines.en: scene barsaraayane11
: Ayane is fine now, Sana...
lines.zh: : 叫 Ayane 就行了，Sana……

lines.en: : And I’m coming.
lines.zh: : 我来了。

lines.en: : Sensei...even though she’s beautiful...remember who it is that’s carrying your child.
lines.zh: : Sensei……就算她很漂亮……也别忘了是谁怀着你的孩子。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane12
Sana takes Ayane upstairs and I find myself alone at the bar with Sara once again.
lines.zh: Sana 带 Ayane 上了楼，我又一次和 Sara 单独待在酒吧里。

lines.en: She takes a sip from her glass of wine, looking me directly in the eyes before saying-
lines.zh: 她抿了一口红酒，直直地看着我的眼睛，然后开口——

lines.en: : Congratulations on the child.
lines.zh: : 恭喜你有孩子了。

lines.en: : There is no child, Sara.
lines.zh: : 没有什么孩子，Sara。

lines.en: : Are you sure about that?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : Yes. I would have noticed if Ayane was pregnant.
lines.zh: : 确定。要是 Ayane 怀孕了，我会发现的。

lines.en: : Mhm~
lines.zh: : 嗯哼~

lines.en: scene barsaraayane13
: But what about me?
lines.zh: : 那我呢？

lines.en: : First off, yes. I would have noticed that as well.
lines.zh: : 首先，对，那我也会发现的。

lines.en: : Secondly, put down the fucking wine if you’re pregnant, you maniac.
lines.zh: : 其次，你要是真怀孕了，就把那该死的酒放下，你这个疯子。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane14
: Relax, relax. There is no baby, so I’m free to get as drunk as I want.
lines.zh: : 放心，放心。没有什么宝宝，所以我想喝多醉就喝多醉。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane15
: And, this might come as a surprise, but that isn’t very drunk at all tonight.
lines.zh: : 而且，说起来可能让你意外，不过今晚我根本没喝多醉。

lines.en: : Reaching out to [younger_girls] for help with marketing...watching your alcohol intake...
lines.zh: : 找[younger_girls]帮忙搞营销……还注意起自己的酒量……

lines.en: : What happened to you?
lines.zh: : 你这是怎么了？

lines.en: : Do you want the sad answer or the really sad answer?
lines.zh: : 你想听悲伤的答案，还是特别悲伤的答案？

lines.en: : Give me the sad answer.
lines.zh: : 给我悲伤的那个。

lines.en: : If I don’t start turning things around for this place pretty soon, I’m going to wind up losing it.
lines.zh: : 要是我不赶紧让这地方起死回生，我最后会失去它。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. I feel like we’ve established this before.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我觉得这条我们已经确认过了。

lines.en: : What was the really sad answer?
lines.zh: : 那特别悲伤的答案是什么？

lines.en: : That I actually am pregnant and am about to lose not only the bar and my home but my daughter and my liver as well.
lines.zh: : 那就是我真的怀孕了，而且即将失去的不只是酒吧和我的家，还有我的女儿和我的肝。

lines.en: : Yeah, that sounds a lot more serious.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那个听起来严重多了。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane16
: Hah...I really can’t do it anymore, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 哈……我真的撑不下去了，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m getting desperate.
lines.zh: : 我快走投无路了。

lines.en: : I used to love running this place, and I used to be so good at it.
lines.zh: : 我以前很爱经营这地方，而且我以前很擅长。

lines.en: : Mine and Sana’s cuteness can only take us so far without any males around.
lines.zh: : 没有男人光顾，光靠我和 Sana 的可爱是撑不了多久的。

lines.en: : Maybe I just need to hire an attractive man to bring in a lot of women and-
lines.zh: : 也许我只需要雇个有魅力的男人来吸引一大堆女人，然后——

lines.en: scene barsaraayane17
: No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : Not even to help little ole’ me?
lines.zh: : 就连帮帮我这个可怜的小女人也不行？

lines.en: : None of the girls I would attract are even old enough to drink yet.
lines.zh: : 我能吸引来的那些女生，连能喝酒的年纪都还没到。

lines.en: : I don’t mind bending the rules a little bit as long as I can pay rent.
lines.zh: : 只要能付得起房租，稍微通融一下规则我也不介意。

lines.en: : I can’t believe someone like you was ever allowed to run a bar in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信，像你这样的人当初居然被允许经营酒吧。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane15
: Anybody can run a bar as long as they can bring in customers.
lines.zh: : 只要能招来客人，谁都能开酒吧。

lines.en: : I just apparently suck at attracting female ones.
lines.zh: : 只是我显然很不擅长吸引女性客人。

lines.en: : So you think enlisting the help of a wallflower and an...Ayane is going to help?
lines.zh: : 所以你觉得，找一堵「壁花」和一个……Ayane 来帮忙会有用？

lines.en: : I don’t expect Sana to be able to do much. But isn’t Ayane the heiress of her father’s bubble wrap company?
lines.zh: : 我本来也没指望 Sana 能做什么。可 Ayane 不是她爸那家气泡纸公司的继承人吗？

lines.en: : She must know at least something about marketing, right?
lines.zh: : 她至少该懂点营销吧？

lines.en: : I mean...she’s definitely a lot smarter than she lets on.
lines.zh: : 我意思是……她绝对比她表现出来的聪明得多。

lines.en: : Maybe she can just get her father to invest in the business or something like that?
lines.zh: : 也许她能让她爸投资这门生意之类的？

lines.en: : Ooooh maybe he’s one of those creepy dads who’s super into his daughter?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，说不定他是那种特别迷恋自己女儿的变态爸爸？

lines.en: : And if I give her a job here, outfit and everything, he’ll show up and spend lots of money...
lines.zh: : 那我要是给她一份这儿的工作，配上制服什么的，他就会跑来大把花钱……

lines.en: : I don’t think I’m supposed to let you exploit my students like that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我不该让你这样压榨我的学生。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane17
: You’re right. I should just ask her to wear it back home and seduce her father with it the old fashioned way.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。我应该让她穿回家去，用最传统的方式勾引她爸爸。

lines.en: : Sara...
lines.zh: : Sara……

lines.en: scene barsaraayane15
: What? She doesn’t have to do anything. Just...twirl around a couple times and say something like, “I love you, Daddy~”
lines.zh: : 怎么了？她又不用做什么。就是……转几圈，然后说句「我爱你，爸爸~」之类的。

lines.en: : That would work on you, wouldn’t it?
lines.zh: : 这招对你也有效吧？

lines.en: : Yes, but I’m a horrible person.
lines.zh: : 有效，但我是个很糟糕的人。

lines.en: : Besides, Ayane’s father doesn’t really pay much attention to her from what I understand.
lines.zh: : 而且据我所知，Ayane 的父亲其实不太关注她。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane18
: Why didn’t you tell me that before I started rambling on about seducing him! Now I feel like a horrible person, too!
lines.zh: : 你为什么不早说，害我一直在那儿唠叨怎么勾引他！现在连我都觉得自己是个很糟糕的人了！

lines.en: : I liked the picture you were painting and wanted to imagine it firsthand.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你描绘的那幅画面，想亲眼看一看。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane19
: Mm! I knew you liked her in the barmaid outfit more than me! I could tell right away!
lines.zh: : 嗯！我就知道你更喜欢她穿女招待制服，而不是我！我一眼就看出来了！

lines.en: : The only way you can make it up to me is by getting a job here and helping me attract new customers.
lines.zh: : 你要补偿我，唯一的办法就是来这儿打工，帮我招揽新客人。

lines.en: : Again, I’m going to refuse.
lines.zh: : 我再说一次，我拒绝。

lines.en: : What if I give you Sana?
lines.zh: : 那我要是把 Sana 给你呢？

lines.en: : Like, in what context?
lines.zh: : 比如，以什么形式？

lines.en: : Like you marry me and become her new step-dad.
lines.zh: : 比如你娶了我，当她的新继父。

lines.en: : Would you really be okay with someone marrying you just to get to your daughter?
lines.zh: : 你真能接受有人为了得到你女儿才娶你？

lines.en: : It depends on the ring!
lines.zh: : 那得看戒指！

lines.en: : Also, it happens in soap operas all the time. I’m basically prepared for it at this point.
lines.zh: : 再说，肥皂剧里这种事不是天天都有吗。事到如今我基本已经做好准备了。

lines.en: : Um...prepared for...what?
lines.zh: : 嗯……准备好……什么了？

lines.en: scene black
Sana and Ayane come back downstairs in their normal clothes and stop halfway between the counter and the door.
lines.zh: Sana 和 Ayane 换回平时的衣服下了楼，在吧台和大门中间停了下来。

lines.en: Sara and I hop off of our stools to meet them and, within a matter of seconds, things proceed to get even more difficult.
lines.zh: 我和 Sara 从高脚凳上跳下来迎上去；没过几秒，事情就变得更棘手了。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane20
: Sana, hypothetically, if Sensei promised to save the bar in exchange for you becoming his property-
lines.zh: : Sana，假设一下，如果 Sensei 答应救下这家酒吧，条件是让你变成他的所有物——

lines.en: : Weird way to say “stepdaughter.”
lines.zh: : 说「继女」的方式真够怪的。

lines.en: : Would you do it?
lines.zh: : 你愿意吗？

lines.en: scene barsaraayane21
: Property?!
lines.zh: : 所有物？！

lines.en: : You can’t have Sana! She’s mine! And I’m yours!
lines.zh: : 你不能抢走 Sana！她是我的！而我是你的！

lines.en: : Do I get to have anybody?
lines.zh: : 那我能拥有谁吗？

lines.en: : No! You just exist, Sana’s mom!
lines.zh: : 不能！你就只是存在着而已，Sana 的妈妈！

lines.en: : You know my name, Ayane...
lines.zh: : 你知道我的名字的，Ayane……

lines.en: : Not anymore I don’t!
lines.zh: : 现在不知道了！

lines.en: : What...would I do as...pro...property?...
lines.zh: : 作为……所……所有物，我要……做什么？……

lines.en: : Your mom is kidding.
lines.zh: : 你妈妈在开玩笑。

lines.en: : What she really wants to know is how you’d react to her and I getting married.
lines.zh: : 她真正想知道的是，如果我和她结婚，你会有什么反应。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane22
: That’s even worse!
lines.zh: : 那更糟！

lines.en: ...It is?
: Fine! I concede! Take Sana! Just don’t get married!
lines.zh: : 好！我让步！把 Sana 拿去吧！就是别结婚！

lines.en: : Wow.
: Those are...uhh...quite the reactions...
lines.zh: : 这些……呃……反应还真够激烈的……

lines.en: : We’re not going to. Sara’s just desperate for a new method to turn the bar around.
lines.zh: : 我们不会结婚的。Sara 只是急着想找个让酒吧翻身的新办法。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane23
: It’s a little more than just turning the bar around, you big jerk.
lines.zh: : 可不只是让酒吧翻身而已，你这个大混蛋。

lines.en: : Hah...my heart...so fast...
lines.zh: : 哈……我的心跳……好快……

lines.en: : Well...umm...I am really thankful for the outfit, Sara. And for always being so nice to me.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那个……我真的很感谢你给我那身制服，Sara。也谢谢你一直对我这么好。

lines.en: : So if there's any way I can help without relinquishing the hand of the man before me, I will do my best.
lines.zh: : 所以只要不用让出眼前这个男人的手，任何忙我都愿意帮，我会尽力的。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane24
: And...umm...Sensei-
lines.zh: : 还有……嗯……Sensei——

lines.en: if amiinvite3 == False:
: If you wouldn’t mind, I’d like to maybe talk to you about something soon.
lines.zh: : 如果你不介意的话，我想近期找你谈点事。

lines.en: : If that’s okay.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话。

lines.en: : Hm? Yeah. That’s fine.
lines.zh: : 嗯？好啊。没问题。

lines.en: : Good luck with whatever weird marketing stuff the two of you are planning on doing.
lines.zh: : 祝你们俩那套奇怪的营销计划顺利。

lines.en: : I honestly...have no idea...
lines.zh: : 说实话……我一点头绪都没有……

lines.en: : But I’ll...do my best...
lines.zh: : 不过我会……尽力的……

lines.en: elif thirdreset3 == True:
: Yeah? What's up?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : Try not to stay too late. Ami might get jealous.
lines.zh: : 尽量别待太晚。Ami 可能会吃醋。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Uhh...okay.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。

lines.en: else:
: We...still need to talk about that thing I wanted to talk about...
lines.zh: : 我们……还是得聊聊那件我想聊的事……

lines.en: : Hey, I'm waiting on you. I am ready for this whenever.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我在等你。我随时都准备好了。

lines.en: : R-Right...
: Well, then...okay. Soon.
lines.zh: : 那么……好吧。就这两天。

lines.en: scene black
scene barsaraayane25
: Hah...[teenager]s are exhausting...
lines.zh: : 哈……[teenager]真是累人……

lines.en: : Tell me about it.
lines.zh: : 可不是嘛。

lines.en: : To think they’d be so opposed to two consenting adults having some sort of relationship together...What gives?
lines.zh: : 真没想到她们会这么反对两个你情我愿的成年人发展点关系……到底为什么啊？

lines.en: : I think it’s less about you having a relationship and more about who you’d be having it with.
lines.zh: : 我觉得与其说是反对你谈恋爱，不如说是反对你谈恋爱的对象。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane26
: Have you always been this popular with girls, Sensei?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你一直都这么受女生欢迎吗？

lines.en: if saradate10 == True:
: I mean...you did date the Niki Nakayama, so I guess you must have been.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……你可是和那位 Niki Nakayama 交往过，所以我想你大概一直是吧。

lines.en: : For as long as I can remember at least.
lines.zh: : 至少从我记得事起就是这样。

lines.en: I manage to make myself sound cool and be completely honest at the same time.
lines.zh: 我成功做到了既显得很酷、又完全诚实。

lines.en: Memory loss has its perks.
lines.zh: 失忆也有失忆的好处。

lines.en: : All the more reason to come work for me.
lines.zh: : 那就更有理由来给我打工了。

lines.en: : Sure. But what can you pay me?
lines.zh: : 好啊。不过你能付我多少？

lines.en: : I can pay you in love~
lines.zh: : 我可以用爱来付你~

lines.en: : Is there a bank around here where I can trade love for cash? Because I have a [niece] to take care of.
lines.zh: : 这附近有哪家银行能拿爱换现金吗？我可是有个 [niece] 要养。

lines.en: : Isn’t your [niece] the one taking care of you?
lines.zh: : 难道不是你 [niece] 在照顾你吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but I’m the one funding everything.
lines.zh: : 是，但钱都是我出的。

lines.en: : She’s not rolling in maid cafe money yet?
lines.zh: : 她还没靠女仆咖啡厅赚到大钱吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think- Wait, why do you know about the maid cafe?
lines.zh: : 我觉得没有——等等，你怎么知道女仆咖啡厅的事？

lines.en: : Oh, I go there for lunch sometimes. The prices are great and the girls are adorable.
lines.zh: : 哦，我有时候去那儿吃午饭。价格很实惠，而且女孩们都很可爱。

lines.en: : I...didn’t think you were the type to go to places like that.
lines.zh: : 我……没想到你是会去那种地方的人。

lines.en: : Of course I am. Everyone likes maid cafes, Sensei. And anyone who says they don’t is a liar.
lines.zh: : 我当然是。所有人都喜欢女仆咖啡厅，Sensei。任何说自己不喜欢的人都是在撒谎。

lines.en: : Well, if all else fails, you could always get a job there. At least you’d still get to wear a nice outfit.
lines.zh: : 那要是实在不行，你还可以去那儿打工。至少还能穿套好看的制服。

lines.en: : I’m not going to let this place fail.
lines.zh: : 我不会让这地方倒掉的。

lines.en: : I’ve decided.
lines.zh: : 我已经决定了。

lines.en: : Well, I’m glad to see you taking a step in the right direction, but you should probably come up with a solid gameplan first.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴看到你往正确的方向迈了一步，不过你大概该先拿出一份靠谱的方案。

lines.en: : I’m trying, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我这不是在努力吗？

lines.en: : I’m asking for help and throwing ideas out there. It’s just that none of them are very good yet.
lines.zh: : 我在求助，也在把想法抛出来。只不过是还没一个像样的罢了。

lines.en: : You’re also closing the bar early. How does that help at all?
lines.zh: : 你还提前打烊。这有什么用？

lines.en: : It’s just for one night.
lines.zh: : 就今晚一晚而已。

lines.en: : It’s not, though. You’ve been doing this a lot lately.
lines.zh: : 才不是。你最近老是这样。

lines.en: : You did the same thing when I walked Sana home that one time.
lines.zh: : 那次我送 Sana 回家，你也这么干过。

lines.en: : You’re not going to bring in any new customers if your hours aren’t reliable.
lines.zh: : 你的营业时间要是这么没个准，是招不来新客人的。

lines.en: scene barsaraayane27
: You...
: You think I don’t know that?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我不知道吗？

lines.en: : If you know it, then do something-
lines.zh: : 你既然知道，那就做点什么——

lines.en: scene barsaraayane28
: It’s really fucking hard, okay?!
lines.zh: : 这真的他妈的很难，好吗？！

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how depressing it is just sitting here for hours on end hoping literally anyone shows up?!
lines.zh: : 你知不知道，就这么坐上好几个小时、盼着随便来个人有多让人绝望？！

lines.en: : It used to be fine! I used to actually make money!
lines.zh: : 以前明明好好的！我以前是真的能赚到钱的！

lines.en: : Now I can’t even make it through one night without trying to figure out which bills I have to stagger to keep all of my shit on!
lines.zh: : 现在我一晚上都熬不过去，还得算计着哪张账单能拖一拖，好让这一摊子还能转下去！

lines.en: : I’m tired! I’m sad!
lines.zh: : 我累了！我难过！

lines.en: scene barsaraayane29
: And the man I like is barely doing anything to help.
lines.zh: : 而我喜欢的那个人，几乎什么忙都没帮。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for yelling. And I know it’s not your responsibility.
lines.zh: : 抱歉我冲你吼了。我也知道这不是你的责任。

lines.en: : But I’m in deep...deep trouble...and...
lines.zh: : 可我陷得很深……很深……而且……

lines.en: scene barsaraayane30
: And I have nobody else to rely on...
lines.zh: : 而且我没有任何别人可以依靠……

lines.en: : I need you to be more than just a friend for me right now. I need you to whip me into shape.
lines.zh: : 我现在需要你不止是我的朋友。我需要你把我给调教过来。

lines.en: : And also just whip me. That sounds fun too.
lines.zh: : 还有直接抽我也行。那个听起来也挺好玩。

lines.en: : You’re not very good at crying, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不太会哭，是吧？

lines.en: : I’m much better at it when I’m by myself.
lines.zh: : 一个人的时候我哭得可好了。

lines.en: Sara’s makeup begins to smear as her tears drip down her cheeks.
lines.zh: 泪水顺着 Sara 的脸颊滑下来，把妆弄花了。

lines.en: There’s no sobbing or heavy breathing or anything like that. Just a single, blank stare and an occasional sniffle.
lines.zh: 没有抽泣，没有喘粗气，什么都没有。只有一片空洞的眼神，和偶尔的吸鼻子声。

lines.en: It’s like she’s waiting for me to say some magic words and make all of the unfortunate circumstances she’s found herself in vanish.
lines.zh: 就好像她在等我念出什么咒语，好让她陷进去的这些不幸全都消失。

lines.en: I can’t do that.
lines.zh: 我做不到。

lines.en: I can’t do anything but watch her cry and pretend to know how to help her.
lines.zh: 除了看着她哭、假装自己知道怎么帮她，我什么都做不了。

lines.en: She’ll see through that, though.
lines.zh: 不过她会看穿的。

lines.en: She might act like a [teenager], but she isn’t one.
lines.zh: 她也许表现得像个[teenager]，但她不是。

lines.en: She’s an adult who’s experienced adult things.
lines.zh: 她是个经历过成人之事的成年人。

lines.en: She’s someone who’s been burned before and it wouldn’t be right for me to burn her again after the two of us have been spending so much time together.
lines.zh: 她曾经被灼伤过；而我俩已经相处了这么久，再让她被灼伤一次就不对了。

lines.en: I guess this is just one of those rare occasions where honesty will need to do the trick.
lines.zh: 我想，这大概就是那种罕见的、只能靠诚实来解决问题的时刻。

lines.en: : I don’t know what to do, Sara.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么做，Sara。

lines.en: : I have zero experience with running a bar.
lines.zh: : 我经营酒吧的经验是零。

lines.en: : I can train you. Believe it or not, I’m still really good when I’m not drunk.
lines.zh: : 我可以教你。信不信由你，我没喝醉的时候还是很强的。

lines.en: : I can’t work here. You know that.
lines.zh: : 我不能在这儿工作。你知道的。

lines.en: : I already have a job.
lines.zh: : 我已经有工作了。

lines.en: : I can’t lose this place...I have so many memories here.
lines.zh: : 我不能失去这地方……这里有我太多回忆了。

lines.en: : I don’t want you to lose this place either.
lines.zh: : 我也不想让你失去这地方。

lines.en: I stand up from my stool, ready to drop a cool one-liner and make a dramatic exit.
lines.zh: 我从高脚凳上站起来，准备丢下一句帅气的台词，然后华丽退场。

lines.en: But it isn’t until I stand up that I realize that I don’t have any lines.
lines.zh: 可直到站起来我才意识到，我一句台词都没有。

lines.en: And that any exit I make while she’s in this condition will be dramatic by default.
lines.zh: 而且她现在这个样子，我不管怎么退场都注定会很戏剧化。

lines.en: scene black
So I do the only thing I know how to do.
lines.zh: 于是我做了我唯一会做的事。

lines.en: I comfort her physically.
lines.zh: 用身体安慰她。

lines.en: I bend down and wrap my arms around her, letting her cry into the fabric of my shirt.
lines.zh: 我弯下腰把她搂进怀里，任她把眼泪蹭在我衬衫上。

lines.en: It is right then that the sobbing begins.
lines.zh: 就在那一刻，她终于抽泣起来。

lines.en: She was doing such a good job at holding back, too.
lines.zh: 她之前忍得那么辛苦。

lines.en: Oh well.
lines.zh: 算了。

lines.en: It’s not bad to let people break as long as you’re there to make sure none of the pieces fall into a storm drain.
lines.zh: 让人碎掉也不是什么坏事，只要你在旁边守着，别让碎片掉进排水沟里。

lines.en: You could also collect them and put them into a box.
lines.zh: 你也可以把碎片捡起来，装进盒子里。

lines.en: There are many, many things you can do with the shattered remnants of one’s well-being.
lines.zh: 一个人碎掉之后剩下的那些残片，可以做的事有很多很多。

lines.en: Especially remnants as colorful as this woman’s.
lines.zh: 尤其是像这个女人这样五彩斑斓的残片。

lines.en: I will protect them from every storm drain in the world.
lines.zh: 我会把它们从世界上每一条排水沟前护下来。

lines.en: : I’m sorry...
lines.zh: : 对不起……

lines.en: : It’s been...a really bad day...
lines.zh: : 今天……真是糟糕透顶的一天……

lines.en: : It’s fine.
lines.zh: : 没事。

lines.en: : I don’t know how I can help you.
lines.zh: : 我不知道该怎么帮你。

lines.en: : But I’ll try to pay more attention for your sake.
lines.zh: : 不过为了你，我会努力多上点心。

lines.en: : Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……

lines.en: : That means...the world to me...
lines.zh: : 这对我来说……就是全世界……

lines.en: I wind up having to carry Sara upstairs and put her to bed the same way I’ve done many nights before.
lines.zh: 最后我还是得像之前许多个夜晚那样，把 Sara 抱上楼、放上床。

lines.en: Just this time it’s from crying so hard that she gave herself a migraine and not the compulsive consumption of alcohol.
lines.zh: 只不过这次是因为哭得太狠、哭出了偏头痛，而不是因为灌了太多酒。

lines.en: Goodnight, Sara.
lines.zh: 晚安，Sara。

lines.en: Goodnight, everything.
lines.zh: 晚安，一切。

lines.en: I go home.
lines.zh: 我回家了。

lines.zh: Sara 的好感度提升到了 [sara_love]!
